subject: Mid-cycle: per-prefix metering skew impacting invoice — reconciliation plan
messages:
From: Sara Iqbal <finance@nebulacorp.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Mid-cycle billing spike for nl-prod-ingest prefix

Hi Michael,

We're reviewing our November invoice and noticed a sudden increase in token usage attributed to the prefix 'nl-prod-ingest'. The jump happened mid-cycle around Nov 18–20 and added ~1.2M tokens to our bill. Can you help explain the root cause and whether NebulaCorp is eligible for a credit?

I've attached a short CSV with our internal job IDs and timestamps (nebulacorp_usage_sample.csv). Tom (cc'd) can share logs if needed.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Iqbal
Head of Finance, NebulaCorp

From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Sara Iqbal <finance@nebulacorp.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@nebulacorp.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle billing spike for nl-prod-ingest prefix

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and the sample CSV. I've started a quick investigation with our metering team. Initial checks show an aggregation window skew for the 'nl-prod-ingest' prefix between Nov 18 02:00 UTC and Nov 20 04:00 UTC where some streaming sessions were double-counted due to a delayed session-close signal.

I need two things to move this faster: 1) Tom's trace IDs for the largest sessions in your CSV, and 2) confirmation whether you routed traffic through our EU region on Nov 19 (we saw a cross-region route that can trigger duplicate attribution in edge cases).

I'll pull the server-side audit logs and a per-prefix sample extract and share back an analysis and remediation proposal by EOD tomorrow. If there's a clear double-count, we'll propose a credit and adjust the mid-cycle invoice.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Li <tom.li@nebulacorp.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Sara Iqbal <finance@nebulacorp.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T13:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle billing spike for nl-prod-ingest prefix

On Mon, Nov 22, 2026 at 11:05 AM Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com> wrote:
> I need two things to move this faster: 1) Tom's trace IDs for the largest sessions in your CSV, and 2) confirmation whether you routed traffic through our EU region on Nov 19 (we saw a cross-region route that can trigger duplicate attribution in edge cases).

Michael — attaching the requested trace IDs inline below (pulled from our ingestion system) and confirming we did a manual failover to the EU edge for a 30-minute window on 2026-11-19 03:15–03:45 UTC to test a rollout. Trace IDs: nl-7891, nl-7892, nl-7903.

Let me know if you need full logs; we can share a secure link.

—Tom

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Sara Iqbal <finance@nebulacorp.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T17:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle billing spike for nl-prod-ingest prefix — analysis & proposed credit

Hi Sara / Tom — Ben from Billing here. We've completed the per-prefix reconciliation with the metering and infra teams. Summary: 

- Root cause: a short-lived race in session-close propagation combined with cross-region ingress caused ~1.15M tokens to be attributed twice for the trace IDs provided.
- Evidence: server-side audit extract and per-prefix diff (attached as redwood_prefix_analysis.pdf).
- Impact on invoice: nets to $1,430.20 in overage charges for the Nov cycle.

Proposed remediation path: 
1) Immediate: apply a pro-rated credit of $1,430.20 to the Nov invoice (posted within 2 business days).
2) Preventive: we'll enable an ingress de-duplication hook for cross-region failovers for your account and add a telemetry tag so future failover windows are excluded from billing attribution until the session-close is fully confirmed.
3) Confirmation: We can issue a one-time invoice adjustment and send an updated invoice PDF.

If you accept this plan, please reply "ACK" and we'll process the credit and send the adjusted invoice. If you prefer a different remedy (e.g., account-level service credit instead of invoice credit), let us know and we'll propose options.

Attachments: redwood_prefix_analysis.pdf (per-prefix diff, sampling logs), nebulacorp_usage_sample.csv (customer sample, provided).

Thanks — we'll also open a short RFC with our infra team and share the rollout timeline.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_prefix_analysis.pdf (application/pdf), nebulacorp_usage_sample.csv (text/csv)
